---
title: Acne support protocol
excerpt: A phased rotation over several weeks—not a quick fix.
focus:
  - stress
severity: persistent
phases:
  - title: Calm and cleanse
    duration: 14 days
    oils:
      - slug: tea-tree
        drops: 2
      - slug: lavender
        drops: 2
    schedule: twice daily
    method: topical-diluted
  - title: Maintenance
    duration: 28 days
    oils:
      - slug: frankincense
        drops: 2
      - slug: lavender
        drops: 1
    schedule: once daily
    method: topical-diluted
---

Sample protocol for tests. Always dilute tea tree before skin contact and patch-test first.

This is not dermatology advice. If skin is painful, infected, or not improving, see a clinician.
